```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(pls)
library(ggplot2)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(rsample)
library(yardstick)
library(purrr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Telling R to skip the first line because exported the csv file using Apple Numbers and it likes to add an extra row at the top that cost me way too much time.
cdi <- read_csv("STAT427_Chronic_Illness_CSV.csv", skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)
```


```{r}
#Cleaning Data
#Alcohol Use
alcohol <- cdi %>%
  filter(Question == "Binge drinking prevalence among adults") %>%
  filter(DataValueType == "Crude Prevalence") %>%
  drop_na(DataValue) %>%
  select(YearStart, LocationDesc, StratificationCategory1, Stratification1,
         DataValue) %>%
  rename(AlcoholUse = DataValue)

#Liver Disease Mortality
liver <- cdi %>%
  filter(Question == "Chronic liver disease mortality among all people, underlying cause") %>%
  filter(DataValueType == "Crude Rate") %>%
  drop_na(DataValue) %>%
  select(YearStart, LocationDesc, StratificationCategory1, Stratification1,
         DataValue) %>%
  rename(LiverMortality = DataValue)

#Joining
joined_data <- left_join(alcohol, liver, 
                         by = c("YearStart", "LocationDesc", "StratificationCategory1", "Stratification1")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AlcoholUse), !is.na(LiverMortality))

joined_data$Stratification1 <- as.factor(joined_data$Stratification1)
joined_data$LocationDesc <- as.factor(joined_data$LocationDesc)

```

```{r}
#Does it look right?
nrow(alcohol)
nrow(liver)
nrow(joined_data)
head(joined_data)
summary(joined_data)
joined_data %>% filter(LiverMortality > 100)
```

```{r}
#Distribution Graphs
joined_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = AlcoholUse)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Adult Binge Drinking", x = "% Binge Drinking", y = "Frequency")

joined_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = LiverMortality)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "tomato", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Liver Disease Mortality", x = "Mortality Rate", y = "Frequency")
```

PCR

```{r}
#matrix
X <- model.matrix(LiverMortality ~ AlcoholUse + Stratification1 + LocationDesc, data = joined_data)[, -1]
Y <- joined_data$LiverMortality

pcr_model <- pcr(Y ~ X, scale = TRUE, validation = "CV")

# Components Plot
validationplot(pcr_model, val.type = "RMSEP", main = "Cross-Validation RMSEP for PCR") 

rmsep_vals <- RMSEP(pcr_model)$val[1,1,-1]  # Drop intercept
opt_ncomp <- which.min(rmsep_vals)
cat("Optimal number of components:", opt_ncomp, "\n")

#Comparing 62components to 10
rmsep_vals[10]  
rmsep_vals[62]  

```


```{r}
# Predictions
preds <- predict(pcr_model, ncomp = opt_ncomp)
df_pred <- data.frame(Actual = Y, Predicted = preds[,1,1])

#Plot
ggplot(df_pred, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "blue") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred") +
  labs(title = paste("PCR: Predicted vs Actual Liver Mortality (", opt_ncomp, " PCs)", sep = ""),
       x = "Actual Liver Mortality", y = "Predicted Liver Mortality") +
  theme_minimal()

#R² and RMSE
SSE <- sum((df_pred$Actual - df_pred$Predicted)^2)
SST <- sum((df_pred$Actual - mean(df_pred$Actual))^2)
R2 <- 1 - SSE/SST
RMSE <- sqrt(mean((df_pred$Actual - df_pred$Predicted)^2))

cat("PCR R-squared:", round(R2, 3), "\n")
cat("PCR RMSE:", round(RMSE, 3), "\n")
```


```{r}
# Prepare predictors
X <- model.matrix(LiverMortality ~ . - 1, data = joined_data)

pca <- prcomp(X, scale. = TRUE)

pc_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x) 
pc_scores$Group <- paste(joined_data$LocationDesc, joined_data$Stratification1, sep = " - ")

```


```{r}
# Top & Bottom 10, PC1
top_bottom_pc1 <- pc_scores %>%
  arrange(desc(PC1)) %>%
  slice(c(1:10, (n() - 9):n()))

ggplot(top_bottom_pc1, aes(x = reorder(Group, PC1), y = PC1)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = PC1 > 0)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top and Bottom Groups by PC1 Score",
       x = "Group (State - Demographic)", y = "PC1 Score") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "tomato")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Top & Bottom 10, PC2
top_bottom_pc2 <- pc_scores %>%
  arrange(desc(PC2)) %>%
  slice(c(1:10, (n() - 9):n()))

ggplot(top_bottom_pc2, aes(x = reorder(Group, PC2), y = PC2)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = PC2 > 0)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top and Bottom Groups by PC2 Score",
       x = "Group (State - Demographic)", y = "PC2 Score") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "darkgreen", "FALSE" = "orange")) +
  theme_minimal()
```


Regression and Classification Trees

```{r}
state_region_df <- data.frame(
  LocationDesc = state.name,
  region = state.region
)

joined_data <- joined_data %>%
  left_join(state_region_df, by = "LocationDesc")

```

```{r}
ggplot(joined_data, aes(x = region, y = LiverMortality)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue") +
  labs(title = "Liver Mortality by U.S. Region", x = "Region", y = "Mortality Rate")
```


```{r}
# Abbreviate labels to avoid overlap
joined_data$StratShort <- abbreviate(joined_data$Stratification1, minlength = 4)
joined_data$LocShort <- abbreviate(joined_data$LocationDesc, minlength = 4)

# Fit the regression tree using abbreviated labels
reg_tree <- rpart(LiverMortality ~ AlcoholUse + Stratification1 + region,
                  data = joined_data, method = "anova")


# Plot regression tree
rpart.plot(
  reg_tree,
  main = "Regression Tree for Liver Mortality",
  extra = 101,
  cex = 0.7,
  box.palette = "RdBu",
  fallen.leaves = TRUE,
  tweak = .5,
  faclen = 0,
  split.fun = function(x, labs, digits, varlen, faclen) {
    # Wrap each label in the vector individually
    sapply(labs, function(label) paste(strwrap(label, width = 25), collapse = "\n"))
  }
)

# Predict and evaluate RMSE
predicted <- predict(reg_tree, joined_data)
rmse_reg <- sqrt(mean((predicted - joined_data$LiverMortality)^2))
cat("Regression Tree RMSE:", round(rmse_reg, 2), "\n")

```

```{r}
#is it a good model?
#RMSE
predicted_reg <- predict(reg_tree, newdata = joined_data)
rmse_reg <- sqrt(mean((predicted_reg - joined_data$LiverMortality)^2))
cat("Regression Tree RMSE:", round(rmse_reg, 2), "\n")

joined_data$Stratification1 <- as.factor(joined_data$Stratification1)

# Create 10-fold cross-validation splits
set.seed(123)
cv_folds <- vfold_cv(joined_data, v = 10)

# Function to fit and evaluate classification model
fit_class_model <- function(split) {
  train_data <- analysis(split)
  test_data <- assessment(split)
  
model <- rpart(Stratification1 ~ AlcoholUse + LiverMortality, 
               data = train_data, method = "class")
  
  predictions <- predict(model, test_data, type = "class")
  
  accuracy_val <- accuracy_vec(truth = test_data$Stratification1, estimate = predictions)
  return(accuracy_val)
}

# Apply function and average accuracy
cv_results <- cv_folds %>%
  mutate(accuracy = map_dbl(splits, fit_class_model))

mean_accuracy <- mean(cv_results$accuracy)
cat("Cross-validated Classification Tree Accuracy:", round(mean_accuracy, 3), "\n")
```



```{r}
# Simplify labels or else it looks bad
joined_data$StratShort <- abbreviate(joined_data$Stratification1, minlength = 6)
joined_data$LocShort <- abbreviate(joined_data$LocationDesc, minlength = 4)

joined_data$MortalityLevel <- ifelse(joined_data$LiverMortality > median(joined_data$LiverMortality), "High", "Low")

# Build tree
tree_model <- rpart(MortalityLevel ~ AlcoholUse + StratShort + LocShort,
                    data = joined_data, method = "class", cp = 0.01)

#Plot manually for spacing
rpart.plot(tree_model,
           type = 2,                  
           extra = 104,              
           box.palette = "RdBu",
           fallen.leaves = TRUE,
           tweak = 0.7,               
           faclen = 0,                
           shadow.col = "gray",       
           space = 0.7)         
```
